game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort, a fort on the sea cliffs: the fisher must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of rogue waves, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort: a fort on the sea cliffs
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Fort, repeat each round: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of rogue waves, dodge the other. Each round, rogue waves strike the sea wall, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the hero_hp value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the sea wall from rogue waves in Cliffside Fort: keep the hero_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: hero_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Else Escape
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Else Escape' (Week 3 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cliffside Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how hero_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cliffside Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while hero_hp > 0.
